endorsements.quote: For resource-limited surgical systems, the safest approach is gradual and practical.
AI tools may not perform safely if they are trained mainly on data from high-income settings and then used in low-resource hospitals without local validation.

unlisted_practices: Strengthen basic safety systems (ERAS basics, WHO Surgical Safety Checklist adherence, documentation, infection prevention, postoperative monitoring, multidisciplinary communication) before introducing AI tools.
Choose AI tools that are affordable, explainable, locally tested, and easy for frontline staff to use.
Introduce AI in resource-limited surgical settings to support specific safety functions such as risk assessment, complication alerts, audit dashboards, or follow-up reminders.
Integrate AI into a culture of teamwork, communication, checklist use, and accountability.

screen.reason: This is a correspondence/commentary discussing recommendations and challenges for implementing AI support tools alongside ERAS protocols in resource-limited settings.
